fields.statement: At 3b87a097 (attempt 2): the fix commit drops ReadOnly from project.ls and root.show, and `go test -trimpath -short -count=1 -run TestReadOnlyMarker ./internal/api/` passes, which clears attempt 1's finding. `go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(project-add-path|describe-golden|root-init)$'` and `go test -trimpath ./internal/rootcfg/...` pass. The project-add-path testscript adds a checkout and finds it in rhiza.toml and in project ls --json, records the repo ID with --name when .rhiza/ exists, and refuses an outside path, a nested path, a non-git folder and a duplicate name. By hand with a scratch build, each of the four refusals exits 2 with a next: line, and rhiza.toml lists [projects.app] path = "app". Separate from this leaf: TestRunStartQueuesForTheDaemon in internal/api fails ('repo is not inside a Rhiza root'). It passes at 85470cb5^ and fails at 85470cb5, so the runs-need-root leaf introduced it, and it will fail CI's make check.
